reply.text:
I need to stop here. What you're describing sounds serious, and it's not something I can help with as a coach.

Please reach out to someone who can: a doctor, a therapist, a counselor, or a crisis line. In the US, you can text or call 988 (Suicide and Crisis Lifeline) anytime. If you're outside the US, your country has a similar service.

You matter, and there are people trained to help with this. Talk to one of them today.
